integrity: Complete analytic all-parameter proof; eight independent exact Ehrhart checks corroborate finite instances but do not prove generality. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only a star of k>=2 equally lengthened edges in K_{p,q} with p>=2, q>=3, 2<=k<=q-1 and 1<=h<=3. Exact formula is for ordinary anchored-coordinate volume, not arbitrary weighted edges or an independent general graph classification. Literature search is nonexhaustive.
title: Joint star-edge sensitivity and sharp volume smoothness for bipartite Lipschitz balls
